mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS id, a.record_name AS recordName, a.warning_id AS warningId, a.warning_record AS warningRecord, a.alarm_time AS alarmTime, a.handler AS handler, a.handle_time AS handleTime, a.handle_process AS handleProcess, a.handle_status AS handleStatus, a.remarks, a.attachment, a.create_by AS createBy, a.create_date AS createDate, a.update_by AS updateBy, a.update_date AS updateDate, b.person_name AS warningMan FROM swm_handle_record a left join swm_warning_management b on a.warning_id = b.id WHERE a.status = '0' order by a.alarm_time DESC limit #{limit}
